scenes: When the grid fails, what keeps running?
For homes, shops and hospitals that can afford them, | diesel generators.
There are twenty to thirty million back-up generator sites in poorer countries, | noisy, polluting, and costly to run.
It keeps the lights on, and adds to the heat. | Steadier grids and clean back-up power break the loop.
Back-up power that doesn’t warm the city.
